rules.name: Null pointers should not be dereferenced

descriptionSections.content: A reference to null should never be dereferenced. Doing so causes a NullReferenceException at run time.

A null pointer dereference occurs when a variable that may be null is accessed without a check.

Noncompliant code example

object o = null;
if (condition)
{
    o.ToString(); // Noncompliant
}

Compliant solution

object o = null;
if (condition && o is not null)
{
    o.ToString();
}
